rationale: The amended plan is implementation-ready as-is. The TWO-PHASE PIVOT correctly implements the Eye's DISCOVERY-001 Option-3 path: Phase A is data-only under sitting v15 (activation-deferred quest-class registration, AM-43 staged non-woven, active_plan/active_authorization untouched, pre-existing gates remain green); Phase B atomically activates under the landed discriminating verifier. Open questions product-1-oq-e6-determinism-deferral and product-1-oq-pd001-nolistener-completeness are thereby dispositioned as non-blocking per the recorded Eye spike directive. No remaining plan contradiction or unsound design; deferred Phase-1b+/multi-engine/self-contained-npm items are correctly out of this authorization's scope.
